scientific_integrity: A self-contained analytic argument is provided, plus finite independent numerical diagnostics. No experiment is represented as a proof of a universal statement.
scientific_limitations: Fixed D,beta,v,r>0 and fixed d>=0, two spatial dimensions; only log right-tail expansion through o(x), not density or prefactors. No uniform estimate as d decreases to zero or for D=0. The role of unindexed general Gaussian-mixture asymptotic results remains a publication-priority risk.
title: Angular erasure in far tails of a harmonically trapped reset active Brownian particle
